title: Characterizing Identifiability and Generalization for Inverse Receding-Horizon Linear-Quadratic Regulator Problems
summary: We consider the problem of objective inference in the context of receding-horizon linear-quadratic regulator (LQR). In this setting, we are given sequential state-action observations, where each observed action is the first control of a newly solved finite-horizon LQR problem. We characterize when the objective of that problem is uniquely identifiable from these observations and when additional observations provide no new information about the objective. We then analyze action prediction at unseen states and show that all objectives reproducing the observed actions yield identical actions…
